excludedRuns: First save probe tried assigning a Comlink API function and logged DataCloneError; fixed with explicit offline HTTP acknowledgement, excluded.
First cache-counter-enriched model comparison treated cache counts as business state; corrected the comparison, excluded.
Early two-frame check did not wait the second frame; not counted as a functional pass.

A private Vitest configuration merged base projects and accidentally started broader suites; stopped, excluded and subsequent commands explicitly select --project option. Backend helpers scope database creation to test databases; this run is not counted as a passing database check.
Private compact test imports first failed to resolve, then used the CommonJS mock entry; switched to the verified ESM entry; zero-test runs excluded.
MemLab non-TTY --help failed in CLIUtils.alignTextInBlock with RangeError; not a successful check. Direct find-leaks commands completed and supplied the retained paths.
limits: Growth cohorts explicitly drain diagnostic pending references/counters; they do not validate backend saves. Raw values are retained alongside drained values.

Cold payload comprises removed subtree bundles only, not all ModelChange/view/selection/reference/collaboration or durable history state. UUID/node-count and byte checks do not establish full undo correctness.
No native/GPU/RSS or application-wide CPU/startup improvement was established.
The 2019 Figma mechanism and pinned open-source comparisons remain in undo-history-growth.md; no competitor runtime benchmark was performed.
